mechanism_cleanliness.baseline_trace_sanitization_rate: 18/36 -- baseline authorizes zero evidence IDs, so any evidence-id-shaped text this 8B generator spontaneously invents is flagged; the guard caught and safely sanitized all 18, zero unsanitized leaks anywhere in the run.
mechanism_cleanliness.note: Hash-binding, candidate-absence MP/ME-off gating, and the fail-closed prompt-drift check all held across all 70 calls, including the retried-after-fix identity (byte-identical messages to the originally approved plan, confirmed by direct diff before re-running).

functional_read.note: The routing/selection mechanism (MS suitability head, RS opportunity router + Step2 card retrieval) is demonstrably wired correctly and produces non-degenerate output. But this weak 8B generator largely ignores the injected candidate content: RS is claimed actually used in only 8.8% of the routed calls where an RS card was present (13.0% among calls that produced valid structured output at all), and MS in 36.8% (53.8% among structurally valid calls). This echoes the earlier independent human-study warning on this same generator family (0/16 verified MS function despite 5/7 quality preference) -- quality preference and verified function have already been shown to diverge sharply here, and this run adds a similar, even sharper divergence for RS.
functional_read.generator_reliability: 11/70 (15.7%) of all calls failed to produce valid structured JSON output at all (meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct capability limit, not a PM/RS/MS logic issue) and fell back to a generic safe reply with generator_claimed all-False.

qualitative_paired_examples: See outputs/pm_v1_5_paper1_rs_ms_evoemo_external_test_analysis_20260812/analysis.json -> paired_examples_where_generator_claimed_ms_or_rs (7 cases). Several show a real, on-topic MS restatement of an explicitly-described change (e.g. rsmsext_31689ed5: baseline gives a generic supportive question, routed reply specifically restates "You're now considering going on a trip with Matthew's family instead of your parents' place") -- qualitatively consistent with real MS function when the generator does claim to use it, not obvious hallucination.
conclusion: The V3 executor mechanism correctly wires the trained MS checkpoint and the real RS Step1+Step2 pipeline into a real, previously-unseen, larger (36-state, 70-call) EvoEmo external test, MP/ME forced off, with zero contamination and zero unauthorized-evidence leaks. This closes the 'does RS+MS work end-to-end on real EvoEmo dialogue outside the lab' mechanism question. It does NOT close the 'does RS+MS help' research question: on this particular weak (8B) generator, RS is claimed used in under 9% of the calls where it was offered, and MS in under 37% -- running the pipeline is not itself evidence of benefit, per the project's own standing rule that baseline comparison and formal blind measurement matter more than completion.
next_scientific_action: A formal blind pairwise quality/risk/function measurement (234l pattern) is still the only way to make any quantified 'RS+MS helps' claim. Separately, the low RS/MS uptake rate on this weak generator raises an open question worth flagging to the user: whether a stronger generator would change the uptake rate materially, before concluding anything about RS/MS's real-world utility. Per explicit user direction, MP rule-based Step1 rescue is the next concrete work item after this external test.
